summary: Tronox Holdings plc filed a Form 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting two routine items: the appointment of Keith Schwarz as an independent director and audit committee member, with standard director compensation including a $100,000 cash retainer, a $15,000 audit committee retainer, and a $150,000 annual equity grant; and the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share, payable October 9, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 10, 2026. Neither event constitutes a special situation; the filing is a routine current report with no strategic corporate action.
